claims.claim: 食利国家的原始定义（Mahdavy 1970）是财政口径：国家「定期获得大量外部租金」，与靠向本国公民征税的「税收国家」相对；定义本身不含政治后果。
claims.quote: Rentier States are defined here as those countries that receive on a regular basis substantial mounts [sic: amounts] of external rent
claims.source_url: VRÜ 4 (1971) S.105 书评 PDF（verfassungsvergleich.de VRÜ 存档；具体 URL 未保留）
claims.source_title: Herbert, 1971, Ein neuer Staatstyp – der 'Rentierstaat'（评 Mahdavy 1970 'The Patterns and Problems of Economic Development in Rentier States: the Case of Iran', in Cook ed.）, Verfassung und Recht in Übersee 4
claims.notes: 引语是 1971 年德文书评逐字转引 Mahdavy 原书 p.428（OCR 把 amounts 识别成 mounts）；未见 Mahdavy 原章节扫描。Mahdavy 关注的是经济发展（消费挤占投资），政治议价权推论是后来 Beblawi/Luciani 加上去的。

claims.claim: Beblawi 1987 把食利国家定义为：只有少数人生产租金、多数人只参与分配，且政府是外部租金的主要接收者；他把它与 Luciani 的「生产型 vs 分配型国家」挂钩。
claims.quote: Fourth, a corollary of the role of the few, in a rentier state the government is the principal recipient of the external rent in the economy.
claims.source_title: Hazem Beblawi, 1987, The Rentier State in the Arab World, Arab Studies Quarterly 9(4):383-398（同名文亦为 Beblawi & Luciani 1987 编著第 3 章底本）
claims.notes: p.385 页面图像逐字核对。同页：「No more than 2 to 3 per cent of the labor force is engaged in the production and distribution of the oil wealth」(p.386)——口径是海湾产油国，非全体食利国。

claims.claim: 「无代表不纳税」反向口号的原始措辞：Beblawi 1987 原文只写「几乎不收税，公民对政治参与的要求就低得多」，括号里引的是正向口号 no taxation without representation；广为流传的「no representation without taxation」不在此文中。
claims.quote: With virtually no taxes, citizens are far less demanding in terms of political participation. The history of democracy owes its beginnings, it is well known, to some fiscal association (no taxation without representation).
claims.source_title: Hazem Beblawi, 1987, The Rentier State in the Arab World, Arab Studies Quarterly 9(4), p.387
claims.notes: 页面图像逐字核对（p.387）。反向口号「no representation without taxation」常被归给 Huntington 1991《The Third Wave》（据称 p.65），本次未拿到该页原文，标 unverified；Herb 2005 Comparative Politics 论文以此为标题加问号。写作时不要把反向口号当作 Beblawi 原话。Beblawi 后任埃及总理（2013-14），属学者-官员身份。

claims.claim: Ross 2001：113 国 1971–1997 合并时序截面数据，石油依赖（燃料出口/GDP）对民主有稳健负效应，在穷国更强，且不限于中东；非燃料矿产也有同样效应。
claims.quote: First, the oil-impedes-democracy claim is both valid and statistically robust; in other words, oil does hurt democracy. Moreover, oil does greater damage to democracy in poor states than in rich ones, and a given rise in oil exports will do more harm in oil-poor states than in oil-rich ones.
claims.source_title: Michael L. Ross, 2001, Does Oil Hinder Democracy?, World Politics 53(3):325-61
claims.notes: 跨国面板（FGLS、年份虚拟变量、5 年滞后，无国家固定效应——这正是 Haber & Menaldo 攻击点）。石油测量 = 燃料出口值/GDP（分母含 GDP，会把穷国机械地标为高依赖）。作者写作时为世界银行访问学者。

claims.claim: Ross 2001 对「税收效应」的直接检验：加入税收变量（个人+公司所得税）后，石油系数下降 17%，税收系数显著为正——税收渠道只解释了部分反民主效应，且数据覆盖 104/113 国。
claims.quote: the inclusion of Taxes produces a 17 percent drop in the Oil coefficient, which implies that the taxation effect may account for part of the antidemocratic influence of Oil.
claims.source_title: Michael L. Ross, 2001, Does Oil Hinder Democracy?, World Politics 53, Table 5 讨论
claims.notes: 作者自己说因果检验数据「incomplete and potentially biased, so the results should be treated as suggestive, not conclusive」。同文引 Waterbury：中东历史上几乎看不到税负转化为民主化压力——反例在源头就存在。机制三分：rentier（税收+支出）/repression/modernization。

claims.claim: Ross 2012 年本人口述：石油诅咒在约 1980 年前不存在；1970 年代前产油国并不更不民主。他把转折归因于 1970 年代国有化让政府直接攫取租金。
claims.quote: Interestingly enough, we didn't observe these problems before about 1980. Up until the 1970s the oil-producing countries were no less democratic, no more conflict-ridden, than the rest of the world
claims.source_title: Michael L. Ross, 2012-03-01, The Oil Curse: How Petroleum Wealth Shapes the Development of Nations（Carnegie Council 演讲转写）
claims.notes: 这是书《The Oil Curse》(2012, Princeton UP) 的作者口述版，书正文未取得。同场：「Much of the oil curse began with these waves of nationalization」。书中改用「人均油气收入」而非出口/GDP。

claims.claim: Ross 2012 同场把税收-问责机制讲成「Petrolia vs Industria」：石油国政府规模约为同收入非石油国的 2–3 倍，且收入不来自向人民征税，因此躲开审视；他另把「保密性」列为关键渠道。
claims.quote: the revenues that Petrolia gets don't come from taxing the people. In Industria, the government has to fund itself. It has to go regularly to the people and ask for some sort of tax contribution, and people may object, they may despise it, but when they pay their taxes they demand some accountability.
claims.source_title: Michael L. Ross, 2012, The Oil Curse（Carnegie Council 演讲转写）
claims.notes: 「2–3 倍」是口头估计，无表格口径。同场：「no country with as much oil wealth as Libya or Iraq, no country with half as much oil wealth as those, has ever made a successful transition to democracy」。对 AI 类比重要：Ross 把「收入规模+不靠征税+波动+保密」四者并列，税收只是其一。

claims.claim: Haber & Menaldo 2011：用 1800 年起的历史数据、国家内时序方法，资源依赖上升与威权化不相关，许多设定甚至呈「资源祝福」。
claims.quote: We find that increases in resource reliance are not associated with authoritarianism. In fact, in many specifications we generate results that suggest a resource blessing.
claims.source_title: Stephen Haber & Victor Menaldo, 2011, Do Natural Resources Fuel Authoritarianism? A Reappraisal of the Resource Curse, APSR 105(1):1-26
claims.notes: 关键口径差异：国家内（within）长期关系 + 国家固定效应 vs Ross 的跨国截面变异。批评对象是「random effects + short time dimensions」。2009 年 Stanford CID WP 386 版摘要措辞不同（无「resource blessing」）。资金：Stanford 内部基金。

claims.claim: Andersen & Ross 2014 对 Haber–Menaldo 的回应：H-M 结论只在 1970 年代前成立；允许约 1980 年结构断点后，石油显著抑制民主转型——因为 1970 年代合同改写/国有化让东道国政府夺取租金（「big oil change」）。
claims.quote: contract revisions that enabled the governments of host countries to seize control of these rents. We refer to this transformation as "the big oil change."
claims.source_title: Jørgen J. Andersen & Michael L. Ross, 2014, The Big Oil Change: A Closer Look at the Haber–Menaldo Analysis, Comparative Political Studies 47(7):993-1021
claims.notes: SAGE 403、CORE 下载被拦，引语来自检索摘要片段，未逐字核对正文；另一摘要片段为「since about 1980, there has been a pronounced resource curse」。注意 Ross 是合著者，等于原作者回应批评，不是独立复核。对 AI 类比的含义：诅咒取决于『谁控制租金』，而非资源本身。

claims.claim: Ahmadov 2014 meta 回归：全球平均方向为「不可忽视的负相关」，但随地区与制度背景显著异质；调节作用主要来自更广泛的经济政治制度，不是先前政体或英国殖民遗产。
claims.quote: While the results suggest a nontrivial negative association between oil and democracy across the globe, they also indicate a notable variation in this relationship across world regions and institutional contexts.
claims.source_title: Anar Ahmadov, 2014 (online 2013-07), Oil, Democracy, and Context: A Meta-Analysis, Comparative Political Studies 47(9)
claims.notes: meta 分析（纳入 29 项研究，据后续引用）。Lall 批评：29 项中 27 项用 listwise deletion 处理缺失值——meta 继承了原研究的缺失数据偏差。摘要另说石油不通过收入/城市化抑制民主，但可能经教育间接作用。

claims.claim: Ahmadov 博士论文版 meta 的量级与测量敏感性：30 项研究 262 个估计，偏相关中位数约 −0.07（加权均值 −0.05 至 −0.09，属「小」效应）；用人均油气租金测量时负效应更一致，加入国家固定效应则估计更偏正。
claims.quote: Ross (2008) suggests a better measure – oil and gas rents per capita. The MRA shows that, across various studies, this variable has a consistently negative and statistically significant coefficient. ... Introducing country-fixed effects, on the other hand, can result in more positive estimates, although the record is mixed.
claims.source_title: Anar Ahmadov, 2011, A conditional theory of the 'political resource curse': oil, autocrats, and strategic contexts, LSE PhD thesis, ch.2 & conclusion
claims.notes: 数字取自论文表（Median -0.07；Weighted Average (N) -0.05/-0.06；Q1 加权 -0.08/-0.09），是偏相关系数而非民主分数变化。论文版 30 项研究，期刊版 29 项。另：「in Latin America oil actually helped sustain democracy for several decades」(Dunning 2008 支持)。测量口径决定结论方向，这是本线最大口径陷阱。

claims.claim: Wiens, Poast & Clark 2014：166 国 1816–2006 动态 logit——资源依赖上升降低威权国家民主化概率（短期与长期），但对既有民主的存续无明显影响。即诅咒是『阻止进入民主』而非『摧毁已有民主』。
claims.quote: We find that an increase in resource dependence decreases an autocracy's likelihood of being democratic over both the short-term and long-term, but has no appreciable effect on democracies' likelihood of persisting.
claims.source_title: David Wiens, Paul Poast & William Roberts Clark, 2014, The Political Resource Curse: An Empirical Re-evaluation, Political Research Quarterly 67(4)
claims.notes: 关键调节变量 = 资源到来时的政体。对 AI 版：若把石油文献当类比，其最强证据只支持『AI 租金会让威权更难民主化』，对已成熟民主的预测力弱——这与 Intelligence Curse 自己「democracy is likely a necessary precondition」的判断一致。

claims.claim: Mehlum, Moene & Torvik 2006：资源对收入的效应取决于制度——「掠夺者友好」制度下资源压低收入，「生产者友好」制度下资源提高收入；博茨瓦纳（钻石约占 GDP 40%）与挪威是正例。
claims.quote: More natural resources push aggregate income down, when institutions are grabber friendly, while more resources raise income, when institutions are producer friendly.
claims.source_title: Halvor Mehlum, Karl Moene & Ragnar Torvik, 2006, Institutions and the Resource Curse, Economic Journal 116:1-20
claims.notes: 因变量是经济增长不是民主/议价权，别混用。正文：「Botswana, with 40% of GDP stemming from diamonds, has had the world's highest growth rate since 1965」；「the resource curse only appears in countries with inferior institutions」。制度测量本身可能受资源影响（内生），作者承认未解决。

claims.claim: Paler 2013 印尼 Blora 县田野实验（n=1,863）：税收处理组相比意外之财组，监督与反现任政治行动更多；但给出支出信息后，意外之财组对被滥用收入的在意程度与税收组相同。
claims.quote: the tax treatment increased monitoring and anti-incumbent political action. Yet, when given spending information, citizens in the windfall treatment cared just as much about misused revenue as those in the tax treatment.
claims.source_title: Laura Paler, 2013, Keeping the Public Purse: An Experiment in Windfalls, Taxes, and the Incentives to Restrain Government, APSR 107(4):706-725
claims.notes: 处理是『信息框架』：告诉被试预算来自税还是来自资源——不是真的征税或真发钱；结果变量为调查+明信片行动。含义：意外之财的『麻痹效应』部分是信息问题，可被透明度抵消。数据 DOI 10.7910/DVN/QWXPUA。正文未读。

claims.claim: Weigel 2020 刚果 Kananga 市 356 个街区随机征收房产税：纳税率从对照 0.1% 升到 11.6%；政治参与（出席市政会/提交政府评价）提高约 5 个百分点（+31%），参与者平均承担相当于一天家庭收入的成本。
claims.quote: It also increased political participation by about 5 percentage points (31%): citizens in taxed neighborhoods were more likely to attend town hall meetings hosted by the government or submit evaluations of its performance.
claims.source_title: Jonathan L. Weigel, 2020, The Participation Dividend of Taxation: How Citizens in Congo Engage More with the State When It Tries to Tax Them, QJE 135(4):1849-1903
claims.notes: 预注册 AEARCTR-0001316；资助 Fulbright、Weiss Family Program Fund；与 Kasaï Central 省政府合作（政府是实施方）。处理是『征税努力』（登记+上门），不是收入来源对比，也不是撤销税收——不能直接外推到『不征税会降低参与』的对称反面。参与形式由政府组织，属低风险参与，不是选举或抗议。

claims.claim: de la Cuesta, Martin, Milner & Nielson 2022：乌干达、加纳 lab-in-the-field + 乌干达全国代表性调查实验——问责压力来自对公共资金的『所有权感』；简单干预就能让人对石油和援助收入产生所有权感，问责需求与税收无法区分。
claims.quote: simple interventions can significantly increase feelings of revenue ownership over oil and aid windfalls, producing demands for accountability indistinguishable from taxes.
claims.source_title: Brandon de la Cuesta, Lucy Martin, Helen V. Milner & Daniel L. Nielson, 2022, Owning It: Accountability and Citizens' Ownership over Oil, Aid, and Taxes, Journal of Politics 84(1):304-320
claims.notes: 机制从『纳税』改写为『所有权感』——对 AI 租金类比关键：若公民被设定为 AI 红利的共同所有者（如社会财富基金），问责需求未必消失。局限：结果多为态度/实验室惩罚行为，非真实选举。Lucy Martin 2023 专著《Strategic Taxation》(OUP) 同线索，未取得原文。

claims.claim: Acemoglu & Robinson 2000（形式模型+历史叙述）：19 世纪西方扩大选举权是精英为防止社会动乱和革命的策略性决定；选举权是对未来再分配的承诺装置。
claims.quote: We argue that these political reforms can be viewed as strategic decisions by the political elite to prevent widespread social unrest and revolution.
claims.source_title: Daron Acemoglu & James A. Robinson, 2000, Why Did the West Extend the Franchise? Democracy, Inequality, and Growth in Historical Perspective, QJE 115(4):1167-1199
claims.notes: 论证型（博弈模型 + 英法德瑞典案例叙述），非计量检验。机制依赖『被排斥者有可信的集体行动/革命威胁』，而这种威胁的底座是劳动力与兵源——AI 版论证正是押注这个底座被替代（见 Intelligence Curse 对无人机/监控的讨论）。

claims.claim: Przeworski 2009（全球数据集，从代议制起点至今的统计检验）：阶级维度的选举权扩展是被底层『打出来的』，对革命威胁的回应；女性选举权则更多出于政党的选举竞争考虑。
claims.quote: The general picture that emerges is that the poorer classes fought their way into the representative institutions and, once admitted, they were organized by different political parties.
claims.source_title: Adam Przeworski, 2009, Conquered or Granted? A History of Suffrage Extensions, BJPolS 39(2):291-321
claims.notes: 计量检验型（以罢工/骚乱等作威胁代理）。支持 A&R 的『威胁→让渡』，但同时给出反例机制：女性选举权不是靠威胁获得的——说明议价权不只来自经济/暴力杠杆，政党竞争本身也能扩权。

claims.claim: Scheve & Stasavage 2010：过去一个世纪，大规模战争动员与税收累进性显著上升相关；在无战争情况下，普选权确立或左翼执政都不系统地带来累进性大幅提高（一战参战国 vs 非参战国 DiD）。
claims.quote: In the absence of war, neither the establishment of universal suffrage, nor the arrival of political control by parties of the left is systematically associated with large increases in tax progressivity.
claims.source_title: Kenneth Scheve & David Stasavage, 2010, The Conscription of Wealth: Mass Warfare and the Demand for Progressive Taxation, International Organization 64(4):529-561
claims.notes: 机制是『公平补偿』（穷人出命、富人出钱），不是革命威胁。对本题：兵役是公民议价筹码的独立来源；若军队自动化，这一筹码与劳动筹码同时消失。样本为富裕民主国家为主，DiD 依赖一战参战的外生性假设。

claims.claim: Scheve & Stasavage 2012：1816–2000 遗产税数据集，DiD 下「普选权假说」证据很少，「大规模动员假说」证据很强。
claims.quote: Using a difference-in-differences framework for identification, we find little evidence for the suffrage hypothesis but very strong evidence for the mass mobilization hypothesis.
claims.source_title: Kenneth Scheve & David Stasavage, 2012, Democracy, War, and Wealth: Lessons from Two Centuries of Inheritance Taxation, APSR 106(1)
claims.notes: 含义双刃：一方面『有投票权≠能拿到再分配』（选票本身杠杆弱）；另一方面说明再分配历史上靠的是『国家需要你的身体』。Tilly 1990《Coercion, Capital, and European States》的战争-征税-谈判论证本次未取得原文（见 open_questions）。

claims.claim: Alaska PFD（资源租金→全民无条件分红）反向证据一：Loeffler 2022 DiD（1978–2000 年 11 月大选）发现分红引入使州投票率显著上升，且持续近 20 年；1982 年首次发放后投票率基线模型 +8.3pp（全模型 +18.2pp）。
claims.quote: Differences-in-differences estimates covering November general elections from 1978 to 2000 provide compelling evidence that the Alaskan UBI has a significant positive effect on turnout. The results further suggest that the turnout increase was not a one-off effect but persists over a period of almost 20 years.
claims.source_title: Hannah Loeffler, 2022, Does a universal basic income affect voter turnout? Evidence from Alaska, Political Science Research and Methods
claims.notes: 只有一个处理单位（阿拉斯加州），DiD 对照为其他州，+18.2pp 量级偏大应谨慎；1982 年也有其他州级事件（分红本身曾成选举议题）。这直接挑战『租金→去政治化』：当租金以公民身份直接发给个人（而非经国家分配），参与反而上升。

claims.claim: Alaska PFD 反向证据二：James, Rivera & Smith 2025 用每年分红额变化（选举前约 1 个月到账）识别——州长选举中现金增加 10%（约 $190）使投票率上升 1.4pp，效应集中于年轻人和穷人，机制是降低政治冷漠。
claims.quote: We find that larger transfers cause people to vote, especially in gubernatorial elections in which a 10% increase in cash ($190) causes a 1.4 percentage point increase in turnout. Effects are concentrated among the young and poor.
claims.source_title: Alexander James, Nathalia Rivera & Brock Smith, 2025, (Alaska PFD and voter turnout), Economic Inquiry 63(3):805-829
claims.notes: 工作论文版（2022, U. Alaska Anchorage WP 2022-01）写作 $182，正式版 $190——引用时用正式版。与 Loeffler 机制不同（冷漠 vs 资源）。两篇都只测投票率，不测议价权/政策回应性：投票更多 ≠ 国家更需要你。

claims.claim: 海湾调查实证（Hertog 2020）：GCC 公民在具体人生选择上确有「食利心态」，但大比例声称支持努力、竞争和小政府；政治兴趣「异常高」但伴随高忠诚和对政府高信任——『政治冷漠』预测不成立。
claims.quote: When it comes to politics, levels of interest are unusually high, but are coupled with high levels of loyalty and confidence in government.
claims.source_title: Steffen Hertog, 2020, The 'rentier mentality', 30 years on: evidence from survey data, British Journal of Middle Eastern Studies
claims.notes: 用多个 GCC 调查（含此前未发表的沙特公民劳动态度调查）；作者解释为国家自 1980 年代以来用社会工程灌输亲商与爱国观念。威权语境下的『信任/忠诚』自报有社会期望偏差。Arab Barometer 原始交叉表未直接取得。

claims.claim: Intelligence Curse（Drago & Laine 2025，论证型）核心机制：AGI 让强势行动者（国家、公司）失去投资普通人的激励，正如资源国因收入来自资源而非对人类劳动征税而忽视公民；作者认为它会比资源诅咒更强，因为 AI 不会耗尽、也会替代军队和官僚中的人。
claims.quote: With AGI, powerful actors will lose their incentive to invest in regular people–just as resource-rich states today neglect their citizens because their wealth comes from natural resources rather than taxing human labor.
claims.source_title: Luke Drago & Rudolf Laine, 2025, The Intelligence Curse, ch.4 'Defining the Intelligence Curse'（intelligence-curse.ai；早期版本发于 lukedrago.substack.com）
claims.notes: 论证型，非实证。日期月份未在页面核对（2025 年，早期 Substack 版更早）。作者把挪威列为 rentier state 又称其为 resource miracle，并承认挪威是在发现石油前已是成熟民主；还承认 Eibl & Hertog 2023 的『威胁→福利』路径（阿曼），但认为 AI 增强国家的监控/无人机能力会使其失效。他们的结论『democracy is likely a necessary precondition for breaking it』与 Wiens et al. 的实证一致。

claims.claim: Intelligence Curse 自己提出的可检验信号：当国家财政收入结构更像挪威（约 30% 来自石油）、沙特（75%）、刚果金（约 1/3 来自采矿）而非 OECD 平均（2022 年公司税占 11.5%）时，就说明智能诅咒在生效。
claims.quote: When state revenue breakdowns look more like these countries than the OECD average, you'll know the intelligence curse is taking hold.
claims.source_title: Luke Drago & Rudolf Laine, 2025, The Intelligence Curse, ch.4
claims.notes: 口径陷阱：作者把挪威（民主、高福利、议价权未流失）列进『诅咒信号』样本，信号本身就无法区分好坏结局——按文献，真正调节变量是谁拥有租金与租金到来时的制度。且信号是『公司税占比』，但 AI 租金可被本国或外国公司获取，跨国可迁移性远高于地下石油（税基可跑）。

claims.claim: Gradual Disempowerment（Kulveit 等 2025，论证型）：明确借用食利国家——若 AI 生成大部分产出与税收，国家会减少对培育人力资本的依赖；并指出『国家主导的再分配（类 UBI）』会削弱历史上的『税收-代表』关系，把对齐负担从经济转嫁给国家。
claims.quote: if AI automation leads to citizens becoming primarily dependent on state support rather than contributing through taxes, it weakens the historical 'taxation-representation' relationship that has been crucial for maintaining democratic accountability.
claims.source_title: Jan Kulveit, Raymond Douglas, Nora Ammann, Deger Turan, David Krueger & David Duvenaud, 2025, Gradual Disempowerment: Systemic Existential Risks from Incremental AI Development, arXiv 2501.16946（v2 2025-01-29；ICML 2025 position paper 版）
claims.notes: 论证型。这是本线与 UBI 话题最直接的连接点：UBI 若由国家从 AI 租金中发放，按此论证会削弱而非恢复议价权。但 Alaska 证据（R21/R22）与 de la Cuesta 等（R16）显示：直接以公民身份分红/建立所有权感时，参与与问责需求可上升——论证与实证在『分配形式』上存在张力。文中提出的可测指标：AI 占 GDP 份额（与劳动、资本分列）、立法复杂度、传统民主机制对结果的有效性。

claims.claim: 对 Gradual Disempowerment 的批评（Bentham's Bulldog & John Halstead 2026-09）集中在『委托≠失权』（类比斯大林把几乎全部工作委托给他人仍未失权）与协调问题，并未回应其税收-代表/食利国家渠道；随后 Max Harms 发文为原论文辩护。
claims.quote: By analogy, Joseph Stalin delegated 99.9999% of the work of running the Soviet Union to people with opaque brains.
claims.source_title: Bentham's Bulldog & John Halstead, 2026-09-17, A critique of Gradual Disempowerment（Substack）；回应：Max Harms, 2026-09-17, a defense of gradual disempowerment（LessWrong）
claims.notes: 博客级来源。批评关注的是『精英』失权而非普通公民议价权；对普通公民而言，批评的『意图对齐的 AI 听命于领导者』恰恰是食利国家担忧的加强版。截至 2026-11 未找到对 Intelligence Curse 食利类比本身的正式学术批评。

open_questions: Huntington 1991《The Third Wave》中『no representation without taxation』原句及页码（常传 p.65）未取得原书页面，只能标 unverified；Ross 2001 引 Huntington 的是 pp.31–32 关于石油强化官僚控制的句子，不是反向口号。
Mahdavy 1970 原章节（Cook ed., Studies in the Economic History of the Middle East, OUP）未取得扫描，定义仅经 1971 年德文书评转引。
Andersen & Ross 2014 CPS 正文与断点估计系数未取得（SAGE 403、CORE 拦截），只有摘要片段；需核对 post-1980 效应量与 Haber-Menaldo 数据重估细节。
Ross 2012《The Oil Curse》书中核心估计（人均油气收入口径下民主转型概率、p.74『no country with high levels of oil and gas income successfully became a democracy between 1960 and 2010』）只见二手转引，未取得书页；本线用的是作者演讲转写。
Tilly 1990《Coercion, Capital, and European States》战争—征税—议价论证未取得原文，未收；Herb 2005 Comparative Politics『No Representation without Taxation?』摘要/正文未取得（作者站只有数据 codebook）。
Lucy Martin 2023《Strategic Taxation》(OUP) 原文与出版社简介未取得（目录站 403），仅有书评转述：统治者会策略性地少征税以避免问责需求。
Arab Barometer 海湾国家原始交叉表（福利获得 vs 政治参与/民主需求）未直接拉取；Hertog 2020 用的是 GCC 多源调查。Eibl & Hertog 2023（威胁→福利，阿曼 vs 赤道几内亚）原文未读，仅经 Intelligence Curse 转引。

AI 租金 vs 石油租金类比的不成立处缺少一手实证：(1) 所有权——石油多为国有（1970 年代国有化后），AI 租金目前在私营公司且跨国；(2) 可分配性——Alaska/挪威式基金证明资源租金可直接按公民身份分配；(3) 可迁移性——油田不能搬走，AI 公司与算力可迁移、税基可竞争（Intelligence Curse 自己也提到国家间竞争会压低 AI 税）。目前文献里没有检验这三点的研究，属论证空白。
挪威：除 Mehlum 等的增长口径与 Intelligence Curse 转引 Steinar Holden 外，缺挪威石油基金对政治参与/议价权影响的一手实证；博茨瓦纳同样只有增长口径。
